prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1176; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's okay. I can confirm I was the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection in Pasadena?

A: I was heading through a four-way intersection on a green light. Another car came from my right side, and it didn't stop for its red. It hit the passenger side of my car pretty hard.

Q: Do you recall the signal for the other vehicle?

A: It was red for them. I'm fairly sure of that because I had just looked up when the light changed for me, and they were already moving into the lane.

Q: How fast do you think you were traveling?

A: Probably around the posted limit, maybe a little under. I wasn't rushing.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The airbag on my side went off, and the belt held me, but my right knee slammed into the dash and the lower part of the door frame.

Q: Did you get medical attention?

A: The paramedics checked me at the scene. I went to the emergency room later that day. They took X-rays and said there was no fracture, but I've been told there's some ligament damage and I'm waiting on a follow-up with an orthopedic doctor. I'm on crutches for now.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'm trying to keep track of my medical bills and time off work, and I'd appreciate knowing what the next steps are for my claim.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
